faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Assistant position at IIT (ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 17th August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma in Mechanical/ Agricultural and have a working knowledge of MS Office, data collection, and data analysis software to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for UR candidates is 32 years as of 1st January 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST/OBC and women candidates as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on merit. Shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview date. The selection process prioritizes candidates who best meet the project's requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 20,000.00 per month for the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their biodata, certificates, and other required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q7. What documents are required to be sent via email?
faq.answer: You need to include a view-accessible Google Drive link to a folder containing your Biodata/CV, self-attested mark sheets and certificates, proof of age, and caste certificate (if applicable) in PDF format.

faq.question: Q8. What should be the subject line of the application email?
faq.answer: The subject line of your email must clearly state: “Application for Project Assistant SRDP1305G” to ensure proper identification of your application.

faq.question: Q9. Can I attach files directly to the email?
faq.answer: No, you should not attach any files directly to the email. Instead, provide a Google Drive link to a folder containing all your documents in PDF format, as direct attachments may lead to rejection.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive. Therefore, candidates can apply without paying any fee.
